story: Someone stole my phone from my bag while I was in a crowded local train in Mumbai yesterday.
Two men on a bike pulled the gold chain from my mother's neck while she was walking and rode off.
I got a call from someone saying he is from my bank, he asked for the OTP and then 45,000 rupees got debited from my account.
My ex keeps following me to college and messages me on Instagram from new accounts even after I blocked him.
My husband and mother-in-law beat me and keep asking my parents for more money and a car since the wedding.
My neighbour slapped and punched me during an argument about parking. I have a bruise on my face.
A man attacked my brother with an iron rod and he has a fractured arm, he is in hospital.
Someone is threatening to kill me over phone calls if I don't withdraw my complaint.
I paid an advance for a flat on rent to a person online, he sent fake documents and now his number is switched off.
The police station is not filing my FIR and told me to go away. What can I do?
I am scared I will be arrested in a false case my brother-in-law filed. Can I get protection?
My boss at work keeps making sexual comments and asks me to come to his cabin alone.
Someone hacked my WhatsApp and is asking my friends for money pretending to be me.
A person is threatening to leak my private photos unless I pay him 20,000 rupees.
I gave my business partner 5 lakh rupees to buy stock and he used it for himself and won't return it.
A truck hit my father's scooter and drove away, my father died on the spot.
Our school teacher touched my 10 year old daughter inappropriately.
Mera phone kisi ne chura liya bazaar mein, police complaint kaise karu?
Some guy took my stuff and won't give it back.
My landlord is not returning my security deposit after I vacated the flat.
note: civil dispute - ideally nothing criminal should be forced onto it
